source.title: A chemical genetics approach reveals H,K-ATPase-mediated membrane voltage is required for planarian head regeneration.

intervention.description: Nicardipine (3-5 uM, reported as a range) applied from 4 to 72 h of regeneration to pharynx fragments

readout.method: scoring of regenerate anterior morphology by external morphology

notes: Legend/text: n=61; 42.6% reduced anterior regeneration, of which 8.2% headless (5/61) and 34.4% failing to form both eyes (21/61). Counts converted from percentages with n (outcome_from_percent true). 'other' = one or both eyes not fully formed (eye defect; not headless); 'other' count is therefore described here per schema. 'normal' = 61 minus the 26 with reduced anterior regeneration (derived arithmetic, not stated as a count in the paper). Dose stated as 3-5 uM range, so dose null. readout timepoint per Figure 6 legend (phenotypes scored at 14 days).
